The '''Perann Nebula''' was a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] located deep within the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="UR" /> It was a vast cloud of dust, rock, and interstellar [[Gas/Legends|gas]] that pulsed with a bloody and forbidding scarlet glow as it [[Radiation/Legends|radiated]] the energy of twelve [[Star cluster/Legends|stellar clusters]] within. The twelve clusters that it surrounded were known collectively as the [[Nihil Retreat]]. The absolute rulers of the Nihil Retreat, dreaded masters of dark magicks, were the [[Sorcerers of Rhand]].<ref name="SM" /> The nebula contained the planet [[Rhand]], which served as a sanctuary for the Sorcerers, since reaching the planet had been impossible without specific coordinates obtained at the Retreat or the guidance of a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-user]].<ref name="UR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The novel ''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]'' first established the Nihil Retreat as "twelve stellar clusters within" the Perann Nebula,<ref name="SM" /> however, ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'' establishes the Nihil Retreat as forming "a protective bulwark around the Perann Nebula."<ref name="UR" /> The [[2015]] update to the ''[[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion]]'' simply stated the Perann Nebula to be located within the Unknown Regions. [[Lucasfilm]] has yet to provide clarification for this discrepancy.
